chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Mohsin ibn Ahmad, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Ismail al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding a husband and two parents, he said: 'For the husband is the half, and for the mother is the one-third, and for the father is what remains.' And he said regarding a woman with two parents: 'For the woman is the one-quarter, and for the mother is the one-third, and what remains is for the father.'
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of the mother and father when the deceased is survived by their spouse and both parents?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the distribution of the residual estate (al-farid) when the deceased is survived by a spouse and both parents, a scenario central to Shia jurisprudence. It establishes that the mother receives one-third of the total estate, while the father inherits the remainder after the spouse's fixed share is deducted, reflecting the principle that the father acts as the primary male heir in the absence of sons. This ruling is often discussed in contrast to Sunni schools, particularly regarding whether the mother's third is calculated from the total estate or after the spouse's share, with Shia scholars generally adhering to the total estate basis as indicated here.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Mohsin Bin Ahmad, from Aban Bin Usman, from Ismail Al Ju’fy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

regarding a husband, and two parents. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the husband is the half, and for the mother is the one-third, and for the father is what remains’. 
And he<sup>asws</sup> said regarding a woman with two parents: ‘For the woman is the one-quarter, and for the mother is the one-third, and what remains is for the father’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhassin ibn Ahmad from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from ’Isma‘il al-Ju‘fiy who has narrated the following: “About the case of a woman who leaves behind her husband and parents, abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘The share of the husband is one-half, the share of mother is one-third and the remaining belongs to the father.’

About the case of a man who leaves behind a wife and both parents, he (the Imam) said, ‘The share of the wife is one-fourth, the share of the mother is one-third and the remaining belongs to the father.’”
